import math
import model_io = "./model_io.qui"

real64 square_root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

class Geometry(real64 length, real64 cosine, real64 sine, int[] dofs)
class Properties(real64 area, real64 inertia, real64 young, real64 yield_stress, real64 density, real64 expansion, real64 stiffness)
class Loading(real64[] external, real64[] total, real64[] temperature, bool settlement)

Geometry[] member_geometry(model_io.Node[] nodes, model_io.Member[] members, int[][] node_dofs)
    Geometry[] result := []
    for member := members[]
        dx := nodes[member.end].x - nodes[member.start].x
        dy := nodes[member.end].y - nodes[member.start].y
        length := square_root(real64(dx * dx + dy * dy))
        result = result.append(Geometry(length, real64(dx) / length, real64(dy) / length, node_dofs[member.start].concat(node_dofs[member.end])))
    return result

Properties[] member_properties(model_io.Model model, int[] choices, Geometry[] geometry)
    Properties[] result := []
    for: i < int(#model.members)
        model_io.Section section := model.sections[choices[i]]
        model_io.Material material := model.materials[model.members[i].material]
        result = result.append(Properties(section.area, section.inertia, material.young, material.yield_stress, material.density, material.expansion, material.young * section.area / geometry[i].length))
    return result

real64 member_weight(Properties properties, Geometry geometry)
    return properties.density * 9.81 * properties.area * geometry.length / 1000000000.0

real64[][] member_stiffness(Properties properties, Geometry geometry)
    xx := properties.stiffness * (geometry.cosine * geometry.cosine)
    xy := properties.stiffness * (geometry.cosine * geometry.sine)
    yy := properties.stiffness * (geometry.sine * geometry.sine)
    return [[xx, xy, -xx, -xy], [xy, yy, -xy, -yy], [-xx, -xy, xx, xy], [-xy, -yy, xy, yy]]

real64[][] assemble(Geometry[] geometry, Properties[] properties, int degrees, int removed)
    real64[][] matrix := [for i := (0:<int(degrees))[] then [for j := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]]
    for: i < int(#geometry)
        if i == removed
            continue
        stiffness := member_stiffness(properties[i], geometry[i])
        for: row < 4
            for: column < 4
                matrix[geometry[i].dofs[row]][geometry[i].dofs[column]] += stiffness[row][column]
    return matrix

Loading load_vectors(model_io.LoadCase load_case, Geometry[] geometry, Properties[] properties, int[][] node_dofs, int degrees, int removed)
    real64[] external := [for i := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]
    thermal := external
    real64[] temperature := [for i := (0:<int(#geometry))[] then 0.0]
    settlement := false
    for load := load_case.loads[]
        if load.kind == "FORCE"
            external[node_dofs[load.target][0]] += load.first * 1000.0
            external[node_dofs[load.target][1]] += load.second * 1000.0
        elif load.kind == "TEMPERATURE" and load.target != removed
            properties_item := properties[load.target]
            shape := geometry[load.target]
            real64 force := properties_item.young * properties_item.area * properties_item.expansion * load.first
            temperature[load.target] = force
            direction := [-shape.cosine, -shape.sine, shape.cosine, shape.sine]
            for: j < 4
                thermal[shape.dofs[j]] += force * direction[j]
        elif load.kind == "SELFWEIGHT"
            for: j < int(#geometry)
                if j != removed
                    weight := member_weight(properties[j], geometry[j])
                    external[geometry[j].dofs[1]] -= weight / 2.0
                    external[geometry[j].dofs[3]] -= weight / 2.0
        elif load.kind == "SETTLEMENT"
            settlement = true
    total := [for i := (0:<int(degrees))[] then external[i] + thermal[i]]
    return Loading(external, total, temperature, settlement)

import assembly = "./assembly.qui"
import model_io = "./model_io.qui"
import postprocess = "./postprocess.qui"

real64 buckling(assembly.Properties properties, assembly.Geometry geometry, real64 inertia)
    return 3.141592653589793 * 3.141592653589793 * properties.young * inertia / (geometry.length * geometry.length)

real64 utilization(real64 force, assembly.Properties properties, assembly.Geometry geometry, real64 area, real64 inertia)
    stress := force / area
    first := (if stress < 0.0 then -stress else stress) / properties.yield_stress
    second := (if force < 0.0 then -force else 0.0) / buckling(properties, geometry, inertia)
    return if first > second then first else second

real64 slenderness(assembly.Geometry geometry, real64 area, real64 inertia)
    return geometry.length / assembly.square_root(inertia / area)

real64 slenderness_limit(int member, postprocess.Result[] combinations, real64[] limits)
    for result := combinations[]
        if result.forces[member] < 0.0
            return limits[0]
    return limits[1]

int select_section(int[] members, model_io.Section[] sections, assembly.Properties[] properties, assembly.Geometry[] geometry, postprocess.Result[] combinations, real64[] limits)
    for: s < int(#sections)
        section := sections[s]
        acceptable := true
        for member := members[]
            if slenderness(geometry[member], section.area, section.inertia) > limits[member]
                acceptable = false
                break
            for result := combinations[]
                if utilization(result.forces[member], properties[member], geometry[member], section.area, section.inertia) > 1.0
                    acceptable = false
                    break
            if not acceptable
                break
        if acceptable
            return s
    return int(#sections) - 1

import math
import model_io = "./model_io.qui"
import assembly = "./assembly.qui"
import solver = "./solver.qui"
import postprocess = "./postprocess.qui"
import design = "./design.qui"

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 total(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result += values[i]
    return result

int rounded_units(real64 value, int digits)
    scale := 10 ^ digits
    units := math.floor(absolute(value) * real64(scale) + 0.5)
    return if value < 0.0 then -units else units

string fixed(real64 value, int digits)
    units := rounded_units(value, digits)
    sign := if units < 0 then "-" else ""
    if units < 0
        units = -units
    scale := 10 ^ digits
    tail := string(units % scale)
    return sign + string(units / scale) + "." + "0" * nat(digits - int(#tail)) + tail

string format_real(real64 value)
    return fixed(value, 4)

int extreme(real64[] values, bool minimum)
    chosen := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        candidate := rounded_units(values[i], 4)
        current := rounded_units(values[chosen], 4)
        if (minimum and candidate < current) or (not minimum and candidate > current)
            chosen = i
    return chosen

bool contains(int[] values, int wanted)
    return model_io.index_of(values, wanted) >= 0

int[][] adjacency(model_io.Node[] nodes, model_io.Member[] members)
    int[][] neighbours := [for i := (0:<int(#nodes))[] then []]
    for member := members[]
        neighbours[member.start] = neighbours[member.start].append(member.end)
        neighbours[member.end] = neighbours[member.end].append(member.start)
    return neighbours

int[] degree_order(int[] nodes, int[][] neighbours, model_io.Node[] descriptions)
    keys := [for node := nodes[] then int(#neighbours[node]) * 1000 + descriptions[node].identifier]
    int[] result := []
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(nodes[model_io.index_of(keys, key)])
    return result

int[] renumber(int[][] neighbours, model_io.Node[] nodes)
    all_nodes := [for i := (0:<int(#nodes))[] then i]
    queue := [degree_order(all_nodes, neighbours, nodes)[0]]
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        following := [for node := neighbours[queue[cursor]][] if not contains(queue, node) then node]
        queue = queue.concat(degree_order(following, neighbours, nodes))
        cursor += 1
    return queue[::-1]

int[] numbering_metrics(int[] numbers, int[][] neighbours, model_io.Member[] members)
    bandwidth := 0
    for member := members[]
        difference := numbers[member.start] - numbers[member.end]
        if difference < 0
            difference = -difference
        if difference > bandwidth
            bandwidth = difference
    profile := 0
    for: node < int(#numbers)
        smallest := numbers[node]
        for neighbour := neighbours[node][]
            if numbers[neighbour] < smallest
                smallest = numbers[neighbour]
        profile += numbers[node] - smallest
    return [bandwidth, profile]

class Canvas(model_io.Node[] nodes, int horizontal, int vertical)
    int x0 := nodes[0].x
    int x1 := nodes[0].x
    int y0 := nodes[0].y
    int y1 := nodes[0].y
    for node := nodes[]
        if node.x < x0
            x0 = node.x
        if node.x > x1
            x1 = node.x
        if node.y < y0
            y0 = node.y
        if node.y > y1
            y1 = node.y
    int width := math.floor(real64(x1 - x0) / real64(horizontal) + 0.5) + 5
    int height := math.floor(real64(y1 - y0) / real64(vertical) + 0.5) + 5
    string[][] grid := [for row := (0:<int(height))[] then [for column := (0:<int(width))[] then " "]]

    int[] position(real64 x, real64 y)
        int column := math.floor((x - real64(x0)) / real64(horizontal) + 0.5) + 2
        int row := math.floor((real64(y1) - y) / real64(vertical) + 0.5) + 2
        return [column, row]

    void .put(int column, int row, string character)
        if 0 <= column and column < width and 0 <= row and row < height
            grid[row][column] = character

    void .line(int[] first, int[] last, string character)
        column := first[0]
        row := first[1]
        dc := last[0] - column
        if dc < 0
            dc = -dc
        dr := last[1] - row
        if dr > 0
            dr = -dr
        sc := if column < last[0] then 1 else -1
        sr := if row < last[1] then 1 else -1
        residual := dc + dr
        while true
            .put(column, row, character)
            if column == last[0] and row == last[1]
                break
            twice := 2 * residual
            if twice >= dr
                residual += dr
                column += sc
            if twice <= dc
                residual += dc
                row += sr

    string[] framed()
        string border := "+" + "-" * nat(width) + "+"
        return [border].concat([for row := grid[] then "|" + row.join("") + "|"]).append(border)

class System(assembly.Properties[] properties, real64[][] matrix, real64[][] free_matrix, real64[][] lower, int unstable, int removed)

class Truss(model_io.Model model)
    model_io.Node[] nodes := model.nodes
    model_io.Member[] members := model.members
    model_io.Settings settings := model.settings
    node_count := int(#nodes)
    member_count := int(#members)
    neighbours := adjacency(nodes, members)
    order := renumber(neighbours, nodes)
    int[] numbers := [for node := (0:<int(node_count))[] then model_io.index_of(order, node)]
    int[][] node_dofs := [for number := numbers[] then [2 * number, 2 * number + 1]]
    degrees := 2 * node_count
    int[][] owners := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then [order[d / 2], d % 2]]
    real64[] prescribed := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]
    int[][] support_directions := []
    for support := model.supports[]
        for: axis < 2
            if support.fixed[axis]
                degree := node_dofs[support.node][axis]
                prescribed[degree] = support.prescribed[axis]
                support_directions = support_directions.append([support.node, axis, degree])
    int[] restrained := [for direction := support_directions[] then direction[2]].sorted()
    int[] free := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] if not contains(restrained, d) then d]
    assembly.Geometry[] geometry := assembly.member_geometry(nodes, members, node_dofs)
    int[][] groups := [for g := (0:<int(#model.groups))[] then [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] if members[m].group == g then m]]
    int[] choices := [for member := members[] then member.section]
    final_system := System([], [], [], [], -1, -1)
    postprocess.Result[] results := []
    postprocess.Result[] combinations := []
    real64[] limits := []
    real64[][] utilizations := []
    real64 weight := 0.0
    int[] governing_cases := []
    real64[] governing := []
    string[] history := []
    int[] deck_x := [for node := settings.deck[] then nodes[node].x]

    System make_system(int[] selected, int removed)
        assembly.Properties[] properties := assembly.member_properties(model, selected, geometry)
        matrix := assembly.assemble(geometry, properties, degrees, removed)
        free_matrix := [for row := free[] then [for column := free[] then matrix[row][column]]]
        factorization := solver.cholesky(free_matrix, free)
        return System(properties, matrix, free_matrix, factorization.lower, factorization.unstable, removed)

    real64[] displacement(System state, real64[] force, bool settlement)
        real64[] vector := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]
        for degree := restrained[]
            vector[degree] = if settlement then prescribed[degree] else 0.0
        real64[] right := []
        for degree := free[]
            value := force[degree]
            for fixed_degree := restrained[]
                value -= state.matrix[degree][fixed_degree] * vector[fixed_degree]
            right = right.append(value)
        solution := solver.solve(state.lower, right)
        for: i < int(#free)
            vector[free[i]] = solution[i]
        return vector

    postprocess.Result case_result(System state, model_io.LoadCase load_case)
        loading := assembly.load_vectors(load_case, geometry, state.properties, node_dofs, degrees, state.removed)
        real64[] vector := displacement(state, loading.total, loading.settlement)
        forces := postprocess.axial_forces(geometry, state.properties, vector, loading.temperature, state.removed)
        reaction := postprocess.reactions(state.matrix, vector, loading.total, restrained)
        return postprocess.Result(load_case.name, vector, forces, reaction, loading.external)

    postprocess.Result[] analyze(System state)
        postprocess.Result[] analyzed := [for load_case := model.cases[] then case_result(state, load_case)]
        for combination := model.combinations[]
            analyzed = analyzed.append(postprocess.superpose(combination, analyzed))
        return analyzed

    int result_index(string name)
        return model_io.name_index([for result := results[] then result.name], name)

    postprocess.Result unit_result(int node)
        real64[] force := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]
        force[node_dofs[node][1]] = -1000.0
        real64[] vector := displacement(final_system, force, false)
        real64[] temperature := [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then 0.0]
        forces := postprocess.axial_forces(geometry, final_system.properties, vector, temperature, -1)
        reaction := postprocess.reactions(final_system.matrix, vector, force, restrained)
        return postprocess.Result("unit", vector, forces, reaction, force)

    void .design_sections()
        for: 1 <= round_number <= 10
            final_system = make_system(choices, -1)
            results = analyze(final_system)
            combinations = results[int(#model.cases):<int(#results)]
            limits = [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then design.slenderness_limit(m, combinations, settings.slenderness)]
            utilizations = [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then [for result := combinations[] then design.utilization(result.forces[m], final_system.properties[m], geometry[m], final_system.properties[m].area, final_system.properties[m].inertia)]]
            real64[] flattened := []
            for row := utilizations[]
                flattened = flattened.concat(row)
            largest := extreme(flattened, false)
            combination_count := int(#combinations)
            maximum_member := largest / combination_count
            maximum_case := largest % combination_count
            weight = total([for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then assembly.member_weight(final_system.properties[m], geometry[m])])
            int[][] changes := []
            real64[] change_values := []
            for: g < int(#groups)
                selected := design.select_section(groups[g], model.sections, final_system.properties, geometry, combinations, limits)
                current := choices[groups[g][0]]
                if selected != current
                    real64[] values := []
                    for m := groups[g][]
                        values = values.concat(utilizations[m])
                    changes = changes.append([g, current, selected])
                    change_values = change_values.append(values[extreme(values, false)])
            history = history.append("round {round_number} weight " + format_real(weight / 1000.0) + " max_utilization " + format_real(flattened[largest]) + " at {members[maximum_member].identifier} {combinations[maximum_case].name} changes {#changes}")
            for: i < int(#changes)
                change := changes[i]
                history = history.append("change {model.groups[change[0]]} {model.sections[change[1]].name} {model.sections[change[2]].name} utilization " + format_real(change_values[i]))
            converged := #changes == 0
            if converged or round_number == 10
                status := if converged then "converged" else "not_converged"
                history = history.append("result {status} rounds {round_number}")
                break
            for change := changes[]
                for m := groups[change[0]][]
                    choices[m] = change[2]
        governing_cases = [for row := utilizations[] then extreme(row, false)]
        governing = [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then utilizations[m][governing_cases[m]]]

    string[] design_report()
        lines := history
        for: g < int(#groups)
            values := [for m := groups[g][] then governing[m]]
            member := groups[g][extreme(values, false)]
            string section := model.sections[choices[groups[g][0]]].name
            lines = lines.append("group {model.groups[g]} section {section} members {#groups[g]} utilization " + format_real(governing[member]) + " at {members[member].identifier}")
        for: m < member_count
            assembly.Properties properties := final_system.properties[m]
            slender := design.slenderness(geometry[m], properties.area, properties.inertia)
            verdict := if governing[m] <= 1.0 and slender <= limits[m] then "ok" else "over"
            lines = lines.append("member {members[m].identifier} group {model.groups[members[m].group]} section {model.sections[choices[m]].name} utilization " + format_real(governing[m]) + " governing {combinations[governing_cases[m]].name} slenderness " + format_real(slender) + " limit " + format_real(limits[m]) + " {verdict}")
        int[] ranked := []
        rank_count := if member_count < 5 then member_count else 5
        for: 1 <= rank <= rank_count
            remaining := [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] if not contains(ranked, m) then m]
            member := remaining[extreme([for m := remaining[] then governing[m]], false)]
            ranked = ranked.append(member)
            lines = lines.append("rank {rank} member {members[member].identifier} utilization " + format_real(governing[member]))
        for: m < member_count
            values := [for result := combinations[] then result.forces[m] / 1000.0]
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            smallest := extreme(values, true)
            lines = lines.append("envelope {members[m].identifier} max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " {combinations[largest].name} min " + format_real(values[smallest]) + " {combinations[smallest].name}")
        for: s < int(#model.sections)
            selected := [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] if choices[m] == s then m]
            if #selected != 0
                length := total([for m := selected[] then geometry[m].length])
                lines = lines.append("section {model.sections[s].name} members {#selected} length " + format_real(length))
        return lines.append("weight " + format_real(weight / 1000.0))

    real64[] magnitudes(postprocess.Result result)
        return [for dofs := node_dofs[] then assembly.square_root(result.displacement[dofs[0]] * result.displacement[dofs[0]] + result.displacement[dofs[1]] * result.displacement[dofs[1]])]

    string result_summary(string kind, postprocess.Result result)
        real64[] values := magnitudes(result)
        node := extreme(values, false)
        energy := total([for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then result.forces[m] * result.forces[m] * geometry[m].length / (2.0 * final_system.properties[m].young * final_system.properties[m].area)]) / 1000.0
        reaction_totals := [for axis := (0:<2)[] then total([for dofs := node_dofs[] then result.reactions[dofs[axis]]]) / 1000.0]
        force_totals := [for axis := (0:<2)[] then total([for dofs := node_dofs[] then result.external[dofs[axis]]]) / 1000.0]
        real64 scale := 1.0
        for value := result.external.concat(result.reactions)[]
            if absolute(value) > scale
                scale = absolute(value)
        verdict := if postprocess.equilibrium_residual(result, geometry) <= 0.000001 * scale then "ok" else "failed"
        return "{kind} {result.name} equilibrium {verdict} max_displacement " + format_real(values[node]) + " at {nodes[node].identifier} energy " + format_real(energy) + " reactions " + format_real(reaction_totals[0]) + " " + format_real(reaction_totals[1]) + " loads " + format_real(force_totals[0]) + " " + format_real(force_totals[1])

    string[] deflection_report()
        result := results[result_index(settings.deflection)]
        fixed_nodes := [for direction := support_directions[] if direction[1] == 1 then direction[0]]
        anchors := [for k := (0:<int(#settings.deck))[] if contains(fixed_nodes, settings.deck[k]) then k]
        string[] lines := []
        for: 1 <= span < int(#anchors)
            first := anchors[span - 1]
            last := anchors[span]
            left := settings.deck[first]
            right := settings.deck[last]
            xa := deck_x[first]
            xb := deck_x[last]
            va := result.displacement[node_dofs[left][1]]
            vb := result.displacement[node_dofs[right][1]]
            interior := [for k := (int(first + 1):<int(last))[] then k]
            values := [for k := interior[] then absolute(result.displacement[node_dofs[settings.deck[k]][1]] - (va + (vb - va) * real64(deck_x[k] - xa) / real64(xb - xa)))]
            selected := extreme(values, false)
            node := settings.deck[interior[selected]]
            limit := real64(xb - xa) / real64(settings.deflection_ratio)
            verdict := if values[selected] <= limit then "ok" else "exceeded"
            lines = lines.append("deflection {settings.deflection} span {nodes[left].identifier} {nodes[right].identifier} max " + format_real(values[selected]) + " at {nodes[node].identifier} limit " + format_real(limit) + " {verdict}")
            postprocess.Result unit := unit_result(node)
            virtual := total([for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then result.forces[m] * (unit.forces[m] / 1000.0) * geometry[m].length / (final_system.properties[m].young * final_system.properties[m].area)])
            stiffness := -result.displacement[node_dofs[node][1]]
            scale := if absolute(stiffness) > 1.0 then absolute(stiffness) else 1.0
            verified := if absolute(virtual - stiffness) <= 0.000001 * scale then "ok" else "failed"
            lines = lines.append("virtual_work {settings.deflection} node {nodes[node].identifier} stiffness " + format_real(stiffness) + " virtual " + format_real(virtual) + " {verified}")
        return lines

    string[] removal_report()
        int selected := result_index(settings.removal)
        string[] lines := []
        for: removed < member_count
            System state := make_system(choices, removed)
            if state.unstable >= 0
                owner := owners[state.unstable]
                axis := if owner[1] == 0 then "x" else "y"
                lines = lines.append("removal {members[removed].identifier} unstable at {nodes[owner[0]].identifier} {axis}")
                continue
            postprocess.Result result := analyze(state)[selected]
            remaining := [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] if m != removed then m]
            values := [for m := remaining[] then design.utilization(result.forces[m], state.properties[m], geometry[m], state.properties[m].area, state.properties[m].inertia)]
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            real64[] movement := magnitudes(result)
            node := extreme(movement, false)
            lines = lines.append("removal {members[removed].identifier} stable max_utilization " + format_real(values[largest]) + " at {members[remaining[largest]].identifier} max_displacement " + format_real(movement[node]) + " at {nodes[node].identifier}")
        return lines

    string[] analysis_report()
        indeterminacy := member_count + int(#restrained) - 2 * node_count
        before := numbering_metrics([for n := (0:<int(node_count))[] then n], neighbours, members)
        after := numbering_metrics(numbers, neighbours, members)
        sequence := [for node := order[] then string(nodes[node].identifier)].join(" ")
        lines := ["model nodes {node_count} members {member_count} supports {#model.supports} free_dofs {#free} restrained_dofs {#restrained} indeterminacy {indeterminacy}", "renumbering " + sequence, "bandwidth before {before[0]} after {after[0]}", "profile before {before[1]} after {after[1]}"]
        for: m < member_count
            lines = lines.append("member {members[m].identifier} nodes {nodes[members[m].start].identifier} {nodes[members[m].end].identifier} length " + format_real(geometry[m].length) + " cos " + fixed(geometry[m].cosine, 6) + " sin " + fixed(geometry[m].sine, 6))
        for: i < int(#results)
            lines = lines.append(result_summary(if i < int(#model.cases) then "case" else "combination", results[i]))
        for direction := support_directions[]
            values := [for result := combinations[] then result.reactions[direction[2]] / 1000.0]
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            smallest := extreme(values, true)
            axis := if direction[1] == 0 then "x" else "y"
            line := "reaction_envelope {nodes[direction[0]].identifier} {axis} max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " {combinations[largest].name} min " + format_real(values[smallest]) + " {combinations[smallest].name}"
            if direction[1] == 1
                uplift := #[for value := values[] if value < 0.0 then value] != 0
                line += " uplift " + (if uplift then "yes" else "no")
            lines = lines.append(line)
        real64[][] movements := [for result := combinations[] then magnitudes(result)]
        for: node < node_count
            values := [for movement := movements[] then movement[node]]
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            lines = lines.append("displacement_envelope {nodes[node].identifier} max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " {combinations[largest].name}")
        return lines.concat(deflection_report()).concat(removal_report())

    real64 ordinate(real64[] values, int position)
        last := int(#deck_x) - 1
        if position < deck_x[0] or position > deck_x[last]
            return 0.0
        if position == deck_x[last]
            return values[last]
        k := 0
        while position >= deck_x[k + 1]
            k += 1
        return values[k] + (values[k + 1] - values[k]) * real64(position - deck_x[k]) / real64(deck_x[k + 1] - deck_x[k])

    real64[] vehicle_effects(real64[] values, int[] positions)
        real64[] effects := []
        for position := positions[]
            real64[] terms := [for k := (0:<int(#settings.offsets))[] then settings.axle_loads[k] * ordinate(values, position - settings.offsets[k])]
            effects = effects.append(total(terms))
        return effects

    string[] influence_report()
        real64[][] member_ordinates := [for m := (0:<int(member_count))[] then []]
        real64[][] reaction_ordinates := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then []]
        for node := settings.deck[]
            postprocess.Result unit := unit_result(node)
            for: m < member_count
                member_ordinates[m] = member_ordinates[m].append(unit.forces[m] / 1000.0)
            for direction := support_directions[]
                degree := direction[2]
                reaction_ordinates[degree] = reaction_ordinates[degree].append(unit.reactions[degree] / 1000.0)
        string[] lines := []
        for m := settings.influence[]
            values := member_ordinates[m]
            lines = lines.append("influence {members[m].identifier}")
            for: k < int(#settings.deck)
                lines = lines.append("node {nodes[settings.deck[k]].identifier} " + format_real(values[k]))
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            smallest := extreme(values, true)
            positive := total([for value := values[] if value > 0.0 then value])
            negative := total([for value := values[] if value < 0.0 then value])
            lines = lines.append("max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " at {nodes[settings.deck[largest]].identifier} min " + format_real(values[smallest]) + " at {nodes[settings.deck[smallest]].identifier} positive " + format_real(positive) + " negative " + format_real(negative))
            real64[] crossings := []
            for: k < int(#values) - 1
                if (values[k] > 0.0 and values[k + 1] < 0.0) or (values[k] < 0.0 and values[k + 1] > 0.0)
                    position := real64(deck_x[k]) + real64(deck_x[k + 1] - deck_x[k]) * values[k] / (values[k] - values[k + 1])
                    crossings = crossings.append(position)
            text := "crossings {#crossings}"
            if #crossings != 0
                text += " " + [for value := crossings[] then fixed(value, 1)].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append(text)
        end_position := deck_x[-1] + settings.offsets[-1]
        positions := [for position := (deck_x[0]:end_position:settings.increment)[] then position]
        lines = lines.append("vehicle axles {#settings.offsets} positions {#positions}")
        real64[][] member_ranges := []
        for: m < member_count
            real64[] values := vehicle_effects(member_ordinates[m], positions)
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            smallest := extreme(values, true)
            member_ranges = member_ranges.append([values[largest], values[smallest]])
            lines = lines.append("vehicle_member {members[m].identifier} max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " at {positions[largest]} min " + format_real(values[smallest]) + " at {positions[smallest]}")
        for direction := support_directions[]
            real64[] values := vehicle_effects(reaction_ordinates[direction[2]], positions)
            largest := extreme(values, false)
            smallest := extreme(values, true)
            axis := if direction[1] == 0 then "x" else "y"
            lines = lines.append("vehicle_reaction {nodes[direction[0]].identifier} {axis} max " + format_real(values[largest]) + " at {positions[largest]} min " + format_real(values[smallest]) + " at {positions[smallest]}")
        dead := results[result_index(settings.rating)]
        real64[] rating_values := []
        int[] rating_members := []
        string[] rating_kinds := []
        for: m < member_count
            assembly.Properties properties := final_system.properties[m]
            nd := dead.forces[m] / 1000.0
            capacity := properties.area * properties.yield_stress
            euler := design.buckling(properties, geometry[m], properties.inertia)
            compression_capacity := (if capacity < euler then capacity else euler) / 1000.0
            tension := "none"
            compression := "none"
            if rounded_units(member_ranges[m][0], 4) > 0
                factor := (capacity / 1000.0 - settings.gamma_dead * nd) / (settings.gamma_live * member_ranges[m][0])
                tension = format_real(factor)
                rating_values = rating_values.append(factor)
                rating_members = rating_members.append(m)
                rating_kinds = rating_kinds.append("tension")
            if rounded_units(member_ranges[m][1], 4) < 0
                factor := (compression_capacity + settings.gamma_dead * nd) / (settings.gamma_live * (-member_ranges[m][1]))
                compression = format_real(factor)
                rating_values = rating_values.append(factor)
                rating_members = rating_members.append(m)
                rating_kinds = rating_kinds.append("compression")
            lines = lines.append("rating {members[m].identifier} tension {tension} compression {compression}")
        selected := extreme(rating_values, true)
        return lines.append("rating_min " + format_real(rating_values[selected]) + " at {members[rating_members[selected]].identifier} {rating_kinds[selected]}")

    string[] vibration_report()
        result := results[result_index(settings.vibration)]
        masses := [for dofs := node_dofs[] then -result.external[dofs[1]] / 9.81]
        free_masses := [for degree := free[] then masses[owners[degree][0]]]
        size := int(#free)
        real64[][] modes := []
        lines := ["vibration {settings.vibration} mass " + format_real(total(masses)) + " iterations {settings.iterations}"]
        for: 1 <= mode <= settings.modes
            real64[] vector := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 1.0]
            for: iteration < settings.iterations
                for previous := modes[]
                    beta := total([for i := (0:<int(size))[] then previous[i] * free_masses[i] * vector[i]])
                    vector = [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then vector[i] - beta * previous[i]]
                right := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then free_masses[i] * vector[i]]
                solution := solver.solve(final_system.lower, right)
                norm := assembly.square_root(total([for i := (0:<int(size))[] then free_masses[i] * solution[i] * solution[i]]))
                vector = [for value := solution[] then value / norm]
            modes = modes.append(vector)
            product := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then total([for j := (0:<int(size))[] then final_system.free_matrix[i][j] * vector[j]])]
            numerator := total([for i := (0:<int(size))[] then vector[i] * product[i]])
            denominator := total([for i := (0:<int(size))[] then free_masses[i] * vector[i] * vector[i]])
            eigenvalue := numerator / denominator
            frequency := assembly.square_root(1000.0 * eigenvalue) / (2.0 * 3.141592653589793)
            lines = lines.append("mode {mode} frequency " + format_real(frequency) + " period " + format_real(1.0 / frequency))
            peak := 0
            for: 1 <= i < size
                if absolute(vector[i]) > absolute(vector[peak])
                    peak = i
            real64[] normalized := [for d := (0:<int(degrees))[] then 0.0]
            for: i < size
                normalized[free[i]] = vector[i] / vector[peak]
            for: node < node_count
                lines = lines.append("node {nodes[node].identifier} " + format_real(normalized[node_dofs[node][0]]) + " " + format_real(normalized[node_dofs[node][1]]))
        return lines

    string[] drawing_report()
        string[] lines := []
        for drawing := settings.drawings[]
            result := results[result_index(drawing.name)]
            canvas := Canvas(nodes, drawing.horizontal, drawing.vertical)
            original := [for node := nodes[] then canvas.position(real64(node.x), real64(node.y))]
            deformed := [for n := (0:<int(node_count))[] then canvas.position(real64(nodes[n].x) + real64(drawing.magnification) * result.displacement[node_dofs[n][0]], real64(nodes[n].y) + real64(drawing.magnification) * result.displacement[node_dofs[n][1]])]
            for member := members[]
                .canvas.line(original[member.start], original[member.end], ".")
            for point := original[]
                .canvas.put(point[0], point[1], "+")
            for member := members[]
                .canvas.line(deformed[member.start], deformed[member.end], "*")
            for point := deformed[]
                .canvas.put(point[0], point[1], "o")
            lines = lines.append("drawing {drawing.name} magnification {drawing.magnification} columns {canvas.width} rows {canvas.height}").concat(canvas.framed())
        canvas := Canvas(nodes, settings.map_horizontal, settings.map_vertical)
        positions := [for node := nodes[] then canvas.position(real64(node.x), real64(node.y))]
        for: m < member_count
            digit := math.floor(10.0 * governing[m])
            character := if governing[m] >= 1.0 then "#" else string(digit)
            .canvas.line(positions[members[m].start], positions[members[m].end], character)
        for point := positions[]
            .canvas.put(point[0], point[1], "o")
        return lines.append("utilization_map columns {canvas.width} rows {canvas.height}").concat(canvas.framed())

    string[][] csv_reports()
        displacement_lines := ["case,node,dx,dy"]
        force_lines := ["case,member,force,stress,utilization"]
        reaction_lines := ["case,node,rx,ry"]
        for result := results[]
            for: node < node_count
                dofs := node_dofs[node]
                displacement_lines = displacement_lines.append("{result.name},{nodes[node].identifier}," + format_real(result.displacement[dofs[0]]) + "," + format_real(result.displacement[dofs[1]]))
            for: m < member_count
                assembly.Properties properties := final_system.properties[m]
                value := design.utilization(result.forces[m], properties, geometry[m], properties.area, properties.inertia)
                force_lines = force_lines.append("{result.name},{members[m].identifier}," + format_real(result.forces[m] / 1000.0) + "," + format_real(result.forces[m] / properties.area) + "," + format_real(value))
            for support := model.supports[]
                dofs := node_dofs[support.node]
                reaction_lines = reaction_lines.append("{result.name},{nodes[support.node].identifier}," + format_real(result.reactions[dofs[0]] / 1000.0) + "," + format_real(result.reactions[dofs[1]] / 1000.0))
        return [displacement_lines, force_lines, reaction_lines]

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    truss := Truss(model_io.read_model())
    .truss.design_sections()
    csv := truss.csv_reports()
    write_lines("analysis.txt", truss.analysis_report())
    write_lines("displacements.csv", csv[0])
    write_lines("member_forces.csv", csv[1])
    write_lines("reactions.csv", csv[2])
    write_lines("design.txt", truss.design_report())
    write_lines("influence.txt", truss.influence_report())
    write_lines("drawing.txt", truss.drawing_report())
    write_lines("vibration.txt", truss.vibration_report())

run_program()

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

real64 number(string text)
    result := real64(text)
    return result

string[][] csv_rows(string name)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name + ".csv"))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    return [for line := lines[1:<int(#lines)][] if line != "" then line.split(",")]

int index_of(int[] values, int wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

int name_index(string[] values, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

class Node(int identifier, int x, int y)
class Member(int identifier, int start, int end, int section, int material, int group)
class Section(string name, real64 area, real64 inertia)
class Material(string name, real64 young, real64 yield_stress, real64 density, real64 expansion)
class Support(int node, bool[] fixed, real64[] prescribed)
class Load(string kind, int target, real64 first, real64 second)
class LoadCase(string name, Load[] loads)
class Combination(string name, int[] cases, real64[] factors)
class Drawing(string name, int magnification, int horizontal, int vertical)
class Settings(int[] deck, int[] influence, int increment, int[] offsets, real64[] axle_loads, string rating, real64 gamma_dead, real64 gamma_live, real64[] slenderness, string deflection, int deflection_ratio, string vibration, int modes, int iterations, string removal, Drawing[] drawings, int map_horizontal, int map_vertical)
class Model(Node[] nodes, Member[] members, Section[] sections, Material[] materials, Support[] supports, LoadCase[] cases, Combination[] combinations, string[] groups, Settings settings)

Model read_model()
    nodes := [for row := csv_rows("nodes")[] then Node(integer(row[0]), integer(row[1]), integer(row[2]))]
    node_ids := [for node := nodes[] then node.identifier]
    sections := [for row := csv_rows("sections")[] then Section(row[0], number(row[1]), number(row[2]))]
    section_names := [for section := sections[] then section.name]
    materials := [for row := csv_rows("materials")[] then Material(row[0], number(row[1]), number(row[2]), number(row[3]), number(row[4]))]
    material_names := [for material := materials[] then material.name]
    string[] groups := []
    Member[] members := []
    for row := csv_rows("members")[]
        group := name_index(groups, row[5])
        if group < 0
            group = int(#groups)
            groups = groups.append(row[5])
        members = members.append(Member(integer(row[0]), index_of(node_ids, integer(row[1])), index_of(node_ids, integer(row[2])), name_index(section_names, row[3]), name_index(material_names, row[4]), group))
    member_ids := [for member := members[] then member.identifier]
    supports := [for row := csv_rows("supports")[] then Support(index_of(node_ids, integer(row[0])), [row[1] == "1", row[2] == "1"], [number(row[3]), number(row[4])])]
    LoadCase[] cases := []
    Combination[] combinations := []
    string[] case_names := []
    case_name := ""
    Load[] loads := []
    source_text_2 := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/loads.txt"))
    for line := source_text_2.split(NL)[]
        if line == ""
            continue
        string[] fields := line.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        if kind == "LOADCASE"
            case_name = fields[1]
            loads = []
        elif kind == "END"
            cases = cases.append(LoadCase(case_name, loads))
            case_names = case_names.append(case_name)
        elif kind == "COMBINATION"
            int[] selected := []
            real64[] factors := []
            for: 2 <= i < int(#fields) step 2
                selected = selected.append(name_index(case_names, fields[i]))
                factors = factors.append(number(fields[i + 1]))
            combinations = combinations.append(Combination(fields[1], selected, factors))
        elif kind == "FORCE"
            loads = loads.append(Load(kind, index_of(node_ids, integer(fields[1])), number(fields[2]), number(fields[3])))
        elif kind == "TEMPERATURE"
            loads = loads.append(Load(kind, index_of(member_ids, integer(fields[1])), number(fields[2]), 0.0))
        else
            loads = loads.append(Load(kind, -1, 0.0, 0.0))
    int[] deck := []
    int[] influence := []
    increment := 0
    int[] offsets := []
    real64[] axle_loads := []
    rating := ""
    real64 gamma_dead := 0.0
    real64 gamma_live := 0.0
    real64[] slenderness := []
    deflection := ""
    deflection_ratio := 0
    vibration := ""
    modes := 0
    iterations := 0
    removal := ""
    Drawing[] drawings := []
    map_horizontal := 0
    map_vertical := 0
    source_text_3 := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    for line := source_text_3.split(NL)[]
        if line == ""
            continue
        string[] fields := line.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        if kind == "deck"
            deck = [for field := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then index_of(node_ids, integer(field))]
        elif kind == "influence"
            influence = influence.append(index_of(member_ids, integer(fields[1])))
        elif kind == "vehicle"
            increment = integer(fields[1])
            for: 2 <= i < int(#fields) step 2
                offsets = offsets.append(integer(fields[i]))
                axle_loads = axle_loads.append(number(fields[i + 1]))
        elif kind == "rating"
            rating = fields[1]
            gamma_dead = number(fields[2])
            gamma_live = number(fields[3])
        elif kind == "slenderness"
            slenderness = [number(fields[1]), number(fields[2])]
        elif kind == "deflection"
            deflection = fields[1]
            deflection_ratio = integer(fields[2])
        elif kind == "vibration"
            vibration = fields[1]
            modes = integer(fields[2])
            iterations = integer(fields[3])
        elif kind == "removal"
            removal = fields[1]
        elif kind == "drawing"
            drawings = drawings.append(Drawing(fields[1], integer(fields[2]), integer(fields[3]), integer(fields[4])))
        else
            map_horizontal = integer(fields[1])
            map_vertical = integer(fields[2])
    settings := Settings(deck, influence, increment, offsets, axle_loads, rating, gamma_dead, gamma_live, slenderness, deflection, deflection_ratio, vibration, modes, iterations, removal, drawings, map_horizontal, map_vertical)
    return Model(nodes, members, sections, materials, supports, cases, combinations, groups, settings)

import assembly = "./assembly.qui"
import model_io = "./model_io.qui"

class Result(string name, real64[] displacement, real64[] forces, real64[] reactions, real64[] external)

real64[] axial_forces(assembly.Geometry[] geometry, assembly.Properties[] properties, real64[] displacement, real64[] temperature, int removed)
    real64[] result := [for i := (0:<int(#geometry))[] then 0.0]
    for: i < int(#geometry)
        if i == removed
            continue
        shape := geometry[i]
        extension := (displacement[shape.dofs[2]] - displacement[shape.dofs[0]]) * shape.cosine + (displacement[shape.dofs[3]] - displacement[shape.dofs[1]]) * shape.sine
        result[i] = properties[i].stiffness * extension - temperature[i]
    return result

real64[] reactions(real64[][] matrix, real64[] displacement, real64[] force, int[] restrained)
    real64[] result := [for d := (0:<int(#force))[] then 0.0]
    for row := restrained[]
        value := matrix[row][0] * displacement[0]
        for: 1 <= column < int(#force)
            value += matrix[row][column] * displacement[column]
        result[row] = value - force[row]
    return result

Result superpose(model_io.Combination combination, Result[] results)
    first := results[combination.cases[0]]
    factor := combination.factors[0]
    displacement := [for value := first.displacement[] then factor * value]
    forces := [for value := first.forces[] then factor * value]
    reaction := [for value := first.reactions[] then factor * value]
    external := [for value := first.external[] then factor * value]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#combination.cases)
        source := results[combination.cases[i]]
        factor = combination.factors[i]
        for: d < int(#displacement)
            displacement[d] += factor * source.displacement[d]
            reaction[d] += factor * source.reactions[d]
            external[d] += factor * source.external[d]
        for: m < int(#forces)
            forces[m] += factor * source.forces[m]
    return Result(combination.name, displacement, forces, reaction, external)

real64 equilibrium_residual(Result result, assembly.Geometry[] geometry)
    residual := [for d := (0:<int(#result.external))[] then result.external[d] + result.reactions[d]]
    for: i < int(#geometry)
        shape := geometry[i]
        direction := [shape.cosine, shape.sine, -shape.cosine, -shape.sine]
        for: j < 4
            residual[shape.dofs[j]] += result.forces[i] * direction[j]
    real64 largest := 0.0
    for value := residual[]
        magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
        if magnitude > largest
            largest = magnitude
    return largest

import math

class Factorization(real64[][] lower, int unstable)

Factorization cholesky(real64[][] matrix, int[] free)
    size := int(#matrix)
    real64[][] lower := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]]
    for: row < size
        for: column <= row
            value := matrix[row][column]
            for: h < column
                value -= lower[row][h] * lower[column][h]
            if column < row
                lower[row][column] = value / lower[column][column]
            else
                if value <= 0.000000001 * matrix[row][row]
                    return Factorization(lower, free[row])
                diagonal := math.sqrt(value)
                lower[row][row] = diagonal
    return Factorization(lower, -1)

real64[] solve(real64[][] lower, real64[] right)
    size := int(#right)
    real64[] intermediate := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]
    result := intermediate
    for: row < size
        value := right[row]
        for: column < row
            value -= lower[row][column] * intermediate[column]
        intermediate[row] = value / lower[row][row]
    row := size - 1
    while row >= 0
        value := intermediate[row]
        for: row + 1 <= column < size
            value -= lower[column][row] * result[column]
        result[row] = value / lower[row][row]
        row -= 1
    return result
